title: Custom Domain Setup
description: Complete guide to setting up a custom domain for your store, including DNS configuration and SSL certificate setup.
content:
Custom Domain Setup

Use your own custom domain (e.g., www.yourstore.com) instead of the default subdomain to create a professional brand presence and improve SEO.

Prerequisites

Before setting up a custom domain:

  • Ensure your subscription plan includes custom domain support
  • Have access to your domain's DNS settings
  • Own a registered domain name
  • Domain must be registered and active

Step 1: Access Domain Settings

Navigate to Store Settings → Domain to access domain configuration.

Step 2: Enter Your Domain

Enter your custom domain name:

  • Full domain (e.g., www.yourstore.com)
  • Choose www or non-www version
  • Verify domain availability

Step 3: DNS Configuration

Configure your domain's DNS records at your domain registrar:

CNAME Record (Recommended)

  • Type: CNAME
  • Name: www (or @)
  • Value: Provided by Tijraa
  • TTL: 3600

A Record (Alternative)

  • Type: A
  • Name: @
  • Value: Tijraa IP address (provided)
  • TTL: 3600

Step 4: SSL Certificate

Tijraa automatically provisions SSL certificates:

  • Automatic SSL setup
  • HTTPS enabled
  • Certificate renewal
  • May take a few minutes to several hours

Step 5: Domain Verification

Once DNS changes propagate:

  • Wait 24-48 hours for propagation
  • Tijraa verifies domain automatically
  • You'll receive confirmation email
  • Domain becomes active

Subdomain vs Custom Domain

Subdomain (Free):

  • Format: yourstore.tijraa.com
  • Included in all plans
  • SSL included
  • No DNS configuration needed

Custom Domain:

  • Format: www.yourstore.com
  • Requires plan with custom domain feature
  • SSL automatically provided
  • Requires DNS configuration
  • More professional appearance
  • Better for SEO

Troubleshooting

If your domain isn't working:

  • Check DNS propagation status
  • Verify DNS records are correct
  • Ensure TTL is set appropriately
  • Wait 24-48 hours for full propagation
  • Clear DNS cache
  • Contact support if issues persist

Domain Management

Manage your domain settings:

  • Update DNS settings
  • Switch between www and non-www
  • Remove custom domain
  • View SSL certificate status
  • Check domain health

Best Practices

  • Choose a short, memorable domain
  • Use .com extension when possible
  • Keep domain registration separate
  • Enable domain privacy protection
  • Set up email forwarding if needed
  • Monitor domain expiration
